subject: Clarifications on SIG questionnaire and artifact delivery
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <security@evergreenbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@evergreenbank.com
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire: a few follow-up clarifications

Hi Irene,

Thanks for returning the completed SIG matrix earlier this week. As we're reviewing, a couple of items need clarification before our InfoSec review can sign off:

1) For control SIG-APP-02 (Key Management), your response mentions "customer KMS integration" and "bring-your-own-key (BYOK) support for Private." Can you confirm which KMS providers are supported in Private (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, HashiCorp Vault), and whether keys are cryptographically controlled by the customer (i.e., never exported from their KMS)?

2) Under SIG-INF-07 (Log Retention), the matrix references "retention configurable per route and exportable via API." Please provide an example retention policy JSON and a redacted one-week access log sample showing the schema (timestamp, request_id, route, principal_id, action, bytes_in/out).

3) SOC 2 coverage: The matrix indicates SOC 2 Type II for the hosted service. Are Dedicated (reserved capacity) customers included in the same report or is there a separate attestation for Dedicated/Private deployments? If separate, what is the process and lead time to obtain a Dedicated coverage letter?

We're trying to close the compliance review by EOD Thursday (2027-04-08). Can you provide clarifications and the sample artifacts by then? If you need a short call, we can do 30 minutes tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Senior Security Analyst
Evergreen Bank

---

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <security@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: procurement@evergreenbank.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: a few follow-up clarifications

Jordan,

Appreciate the quick review — answering inline below and attaching a short artifact bundle. High level: Private deployments support customer-managed KMS (customer keys remain in their KMS and are used for envelope encryption; Redwood never exports raw key material). See attached redwood_soc2_summary.pdf for our control language and the redwood_sig_response_matrix.xlsx for updated cells with vendor specifics.

1) KMS support and key ownership:
- Supported providers for Private: AWS KMS (including CloudHSM-backed keys), Azure Key Vault, Google Cloud KMS, and HashiCorp Vault (self-hosted).
- Key ownership: In Private deployments the customer provisions keys inside their KMS and configures Redwood to use them for encryption-at-rest and envelope encryption. We perform EKM-style calls; private keys do not leave the customer's KMS. For Hosted and Dedicated, we provide KMS integration (customer-managed key) for encryption-at-rest when requested under an enterprise account; otherwise Redwood-managed keys are used by default.

2) Log retention and sample:
- We support per-route retention policies via the Console/API. Example policy (simplified): {"route":"/v1/generate", "retention_days":30, "export_uri":"s3://evb-logs/redwood/"}.
- Attached: sample_access_log_snippet.txt (redacted request_id and principal_id fields). The schema columns are: timestamp, request_id, route, model, principal_id, action, latency_ms, response_size_bytes.

3) SOC 2 scope for Dedicated:
- Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covers our Hosted API and the Redwood Control Plane. For Dedicated customers, there are two options: (a) if the customer uses Redwood Dedicated with Redwood-managed control plane and agrees to the standard Dedicated addendum, we provide an SOC 2 coverage letter that maps the control boundaries (we included a template in the Drive link); (b) for fully private/on-prem deployments where the control plane is self-hosted by the customer, SOC 2 coverage is limited to the Redwood-delivered components and we produce a scoped coverage letter plus guidance for customer evidence they must supply.
- Lead time: standard coverage letters are issued within 3 business days after contractual signature and provisioning; scoped attestations for unique Dedicated configs typically require 2-3 weeks due to auditor coordination.

Attachments included: redwood_sig_response_matrix.xlsx (updated cells), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary of attestations), sample_access_log_snippet.txt (redacted), network_arch_diagram_v2.png (Private deployment network overlay).

If helpful, Marissa (copied) can provide the access log sample format and a brief walkthrough. Happy to take the 30-minute call if you want to step through any artifacts tomorrow.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Compliance & Security
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <security@evergreenbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@evergreenbank.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: a few follow-up clarifications (log schema details)

Jordan / Irene,

Following up with the technical schema for the access log export and a short note on redaction. We generated the redacted one-week sample attached to Irene's message. Notes:
- Log record (CSV): iso_ts, request_id, route, model, principal_id, principal_type, status_code, latency_ms, bytes_in, bytes_out, user_agent, source_ip (redacted to /24).
- Redaction policy: principal_id is hashed with an HMAC keyed by an ephemeral per-export key; source_ip is truncated to /24. We maintain a separate internal mapping for debug-only access (auditable via the Console Audit Log).
- Export formats: CSV and JSONL supported. Exports are delivered to customer-specified S3/GCS container or via secure transfer appliance for air-gapped Private installs.

If you need a small sample in JSONL (instead of CSV) we can regenerate it. Also pointing to the Drive link where the export job template and policy are stored.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Regards,
Jordan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <security@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@evergreenbank.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: a few follow-up clarifications (SOC 2 clause and S3 flow)

Jordan — quick note to close the open items before your legal review. Per Irene's summary above, action items and proposed language attached.

1) Contract clause (proposed): "Customer-managed keys: Customer may configure a customer-managed key (CMK) in a supported KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS, HashiCorp Vault). Redwood will perform envelope encryption using the customer's CMK via remote key operations (e.g., Encrypt/Decrypt or GenerateDataKey). Customer keys are not exported or persisted by Redwood in raw key form. Redwood will provide a coverage letter mapping this configuration to SIG-APP-02 upon request." (We attached a .docx template in Drive.)

2) S3 push flow: Confirmed. Export jobs may be configured to push directly into the customer's S3 bucket using an IAM role established by the customer (best practice). Required ACLs: PutObject and PutObjectAcl permissions for the export role. For extra security the customer can provide a KMS key to encrypt exported objects; Redwood will write with server-side encryption using the customer key (SSE-KMS). Details and an export job template are in the linked Drive folder.

3) SOC 2 coverage letter turnaround: We issue a standard Dedicated coverage letter within 3 business days of contract signature and account provisioning; this is included as a non-binding operational target in our Enterprise addendum. If you require a contractual SLA (guaranteed), we can include a 3-business-day SLA in the enterprise addendum subject to a modest service-level fee; otherwise the standard process is best-effort with historical 100% compliance within the 3-day window.

Next steps: Irene will upload the proposed clause and a coverage-letter template to the Drive link; Marissa will create an export job template in your S3 format if you share the bucket name/role. If you want the coverage letter added as a contract exhibit, let us know and we'll route to Legal.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product & Compliance
Redwood Inference
